estimate_label: estimates come from measured calibration rates; observed values are measured durations of this run
limitations: Recall@50 is recall of known positives inside the fixed natural BM25 top-50; it is not exhaustive relevance.
Intervals describe the sampled evidence groups, not future users; a single-split result is not a population guarantee.
Rerankers only reorder the same frozen candidate lists; known positives outside a list were judged but never inserted into retrieval.

DIAGNOSTIC REHEARSAL: synthetic documents and questions, a scripted oracle standing in for a reviewer and a random tiny encoder; these numbers describe the plumbing and say nothing about ranking quality.
Queries are SYNTHETIC (generated by an agent workflow); they are not real user questions.
All judgments come from AGENT review; no human reviewer judged any item.

validation_decision.reason: qualified under the predeclared validation gates
